d: STS Aviation Services is hiring an experienced Accountant to join its finance team in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
This position supports day-to-day accounting operations, including supplier payments, airline customer billing and collections, month-end financial reporting and compliance with UAE tax requirements.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, the Accountant will work closely with operations, procurement and programme teams to maintain accurate financial records, support internal controls and contribute to the company’s financial operations.

The Accountant is responsible for supporting the company’s accounting activities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, month-end closing, financial reconciliations and regulatory compliance.

This role requires strong knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), UAE Corporate Tax and VAT regulations, along with hands-on experience using financial ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
The successful candidate will have three to five years of full-cycle accounting experience, including at least two years working in the UAE, and hold an ACCA, CPA or CMA qualification.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance
ACCA, CPA or CMA qualification required
Three to five years of full-cycle accounting experience covering accounts payable, accounts receivable and month-end closing
Minimum of two years of accounting experience in the UAE
Working knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)
Knowledge of UAE Corporate Tax and VAT regulations
Proficiency in financial ERP systems, such as Acumatica
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively
Previous experience in aviation, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) or engineering services
STS Aviation Services is a global aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) provider and part of STS Aviation Group.

With operations across Europe, the Middle East and North America, STS Aviation Services supports commercial and military aviation customers through aircraft maintenance, modifications, engineering support and technical services.

If you have full-cycle accounting experience, strong knowledge of UAE tax regulations and the qualifications required for this position, we encourage you to apply for this Accountant opportunity in Dubai. Simply click the “Apply” button on this page to submit your application.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
r: Process supplier invoices using three-way matching in Acumatica

Post and allocate customer receipts to ensure no unapplied cash remains at month-end
Follow up on overdue customer balances
Support the resolution of billing disputes and credit notes
Support month-end closing activities according to the agreed reporting calendar
Prepare accruals for goods and services received but not yet invoiced
Reconcile all balance sheet accounts monthly
Support the preparation of management accounts
Assist with the preparation of the year-end audit file
Support the preparation of transfer pricing documentation
Work with external advisers to monitor cross-border tax exposure
Monitor taxable supplies against the mandatory UAE VAT registration threshold
Maintain accurate and up-to-date Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) filings
Keep other required regulatory filings up to date
Maintain documented accounting processes and internal controls
Identify and support process improvements and automation
Provide ad-hoc financial analysis as required

During Your Tenure As An Assistant Manager In Audit & Assurance, You Will Demonstrate And Develop Your Capabilities In The Following Areas

Takes responsibility for understanding key statistics and industry matters about entity before engagement begins, for example, by asking other team members and reading the prior year financial statements (including the enhanced audit report) or audit documentation.

Understands allocation of responsibilities between the engagement team and experts or specialists, including timescales and how the work of experts and specialists will contribute to the objectives of the audit.

Coordinates with management and expert/specialists for the key engagement or project deliverables and due dates. Track’s findings of work performed and follows up the impact of work to be performed by other members of the engagement team.

Applies guidance material in relevant guides, practice aids, and tools so that an appropriate level of professional skepticism is reflected in procedures performed, evidence obtained, and conclusions reached.

Signs off appropriately on work performed and reviewed. Takes responsibility for meaningful completion of all necessary checklists, procedures and tailoring and concluding questions prior to signing-off. Proactively checks whether others have signed off appropriately and follows up where necessary.

Contributes to the development of a comprehensive project plan, using prior year knowledge to help identify audit priorities that can be performed earlier in the audit cycle. Seeks awareness of contingency plans if the entity's management team fails to meet their deadlines.

Prepares and reviews documentation by anticipating questions that reviewers may ask, including not just the conclusion but the relevant facts, analysis, reference to authoritative literature and professional judgements made in reaching it.

Encourages wider team adopt an attitude of professional skepticism, to have a questioning mind-set and to further investigate as and when appropriate. Is able to identify the key questions to be answered.
Document’s objectivity, independence, and continuance decisions, checking that sufficient enquiries have been made and that all information has been captured.
Checks that staff on the engagement have adequate technical knowledge, including industry knowledge, for the areas in which they are working. Provides briefings as required.

d: SRT Marine Systems plc (SRT) are a market leader in its domain of international marine surveillance technology and systems. We are respected, established and an ambitious multi-national company headquartered in the UK with a global customer base.

The company has a global impact in the marine domain by leading the next generation of Maritime Domain Awareness 'MDA' technologies, products and systems that significantly enhance, security, safety and environment protection and sustainability. Our customers are worldwide and range from the largest national coast guards to individual vessel owners.

SRT is an exciting company where high-quality results are rewarded. We are ambitious and are constantly seeking to innovate to deliver better products and services to our customers. We strive to make SRT a rewarding and challenging place to work where talented hard-working individuals have the opportunity to make a real impact across the marine world.

You as our Senior Construction Director will work on SRT projects in the Middle East region. This is an extremely hands-on, site-facing role supporting the Programme Director by leading project delivery, coordinating assigned workstreams, and controlling delivery against agreed scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk and customer commitments.
Role Overview of our Senior Construction Director

The Senior Construction Director will coordinate ICP, design consultants, subcontractors and internal SRT teams through design development, construction readiness, installation and acceptance. The role will also act as design manager/coordinator during design development, overseeing the ICP design consultant and managing design reviews, comment close-out, approvals and alignment with SRT technical requirements, customer obligations and site delivery constraints. This is an extremely "Hands-on" role and the expectation is for a majority of time to be spent on each of our project sites.
